ops.name: Mender's Faith
ops.value: Improves your |Heal| to restore an additional 75 Health and reduces its cooldown by 10 seconds
ops.note: Launch form. Per-mastery wiki page instead claims 10-180 bonus heal from June 2009; the Heal page and the V1.0.0.52 note say 75 flat + 10 s CDR.

ops.name: Reinforce
ops.value: While your |Fortify| is available, your champion deals 9 bonus damage to minions and monsters
ops.note: Pre-V1.0.0.61 Reinforce (V0.9.22.7 raised the minion bonus to +9 from +6; Fortify itself splashed). The beta text also gave turrets bonus armor after Fortify; unknown whether that survived to launch.

ops.name: Willpower
ops.value: Reduces the cooldown of |Cleanse| by 30 seconds

ops.name: Cripple
ops.value: Improves your |Exhaust| to also reduce the target's Armor and Magic Resist by 25 and increases its duration by 0.5 seconds

ops.name: Improved Rally
ops.value: Improves your |Rally| to also increase base magic damage dealt by 20% and increases its duration by 5 seconds
ops.note: Values from the V1.0.0.72 note ("instead of a 20% increase to base magic damage dealt"); wording reconstructed.

ops.name: Haste
ops.value: Improves your |Ghost| to increase its Movement Speed by 8% and its duration by 1.5 seconds

ops.name: Ardor
ops.value: +#% Ability Power and +#% Attack Speed (half at champion level 1, scaling up to the full amount at level 18)
ops.note: V1.0.0.109: "Now provides all of its benefit at level 1 rather than half at level 1 and the other half scaling up to level 18". Max values 1.33/2.66/4 unchanged; wording reconstructed.

ops.name: Strength of Spirit
ops.note: Pre-V1.0.0.110 the tooltip gave 0.1/0.2/0.3% of max mana per second (= 0.5/1/1.5 per 5 s); V1.0.0.110 cut it ~33% and switched the tooltip to per-5.

ops.name: Meditation
ops.note: Shown pre-110 as 0.33/0.66/1 per second; values here are the per-5 equivalents the patch note uses.

ops.name: Havoc
ops.value: Increases your base physical damage and base magic damage by 5%
